trustedBridge: formal/scripts/extract-arithmetic.mjs interprets selected TypeScript AST arithmetic over mathematical rationals; it is not a proved compiler
scope: Mathematical rational arithmetic, segment membership, all intersection branches, cut completeness, sorted geometric edges, and arithmetic lemmas for left-side face sampling; selected extracted arithmetic expressions. Affine cross-product scaling, interpolation, inverse and segment membership. Signed volume formula for an oriented rational triangular prism. Rational 3D plane evaluation, orientation, unique intersection parameter and complete segment/plane intersection existence criterion. Barycentric plane evaluation/bounds and quadrilateral fan area-vector preservation. Coplanar plane-coordinate lifting satisfies the plane and uniquely restores the omitted coordinate. Cached oriented edge halfplane identity and nonparallel ray parameter invariance under nonzero plane rescaling. Line/circle substitution and radical-axis identities/equivalence over commutative rings; rational circumcenter linear equations. Uniqueness of same-x circle points in a common closed vertical half over ordered fields. Canonical nonvertical line-frame identity over fields. Linear cancellation of shared-point circle tangent cross products and exact small-circle normal offset for circular germs. Circular cylinder projection, axis shift/scale, line-substitution polynomial and non-unit normal identities over commutative rings. Spatial sphere line-substitution, two-plane Gram intersection coefficients and circle-basis orientation identities.
limitations: Not a verification of the entire TypeScript program or ECMAScript runtime.
Parsing, BigInt runtime behavior, exceptions, Map/array/sort/freeze execution and compilation are outside this proof scope.
Source arithmetic extraction and its interpretation of Rational methods remain trusted.
Triangle topology welding, incidence/link diagnostics, shell traversal and boundary loops are tested and documented with hand invariants, not machine-verified.

Triangle/triangle intersection candidate enumeration, convex hull construction and all-pairs embedding inspection are covered by independent tests and hand proofs, not whole-program machine verification.
Solid certification, rational generic-ray termination, PL separation and shell nesting are documented and independently tested, not machine-verified.
Incremental triangle/plane arrangement clipping and strict interior witnesses are tested with independent halfplane enumeration and documented inductive invariants, not machine-verified.

Polyhedral Boolean plane grouping, coverage, two-sided sampling, boundary sewing, contact complexes and result provenance use documented construction arguments and independent tests, not whole-program machine verification.

Solid locator plane grouping, cached data structures and strict coordinate-bound rejection are justified by arithmetic lemmas, geometric arguments and independent tests; the full cached query execution is not machine-verified.

Rational polynomial arithmetic, square-free reduction, Sturm counting/isolation and algebraic root predicates are documented and checked with independent integer/factor/CAS oracles, not machine-verified.

Algebraic root affine composition, correlated algebraic point construction, line/segment/circle intersections and circle predicates are tested with independent integer oracles and documented reductions; complete TypeScript execution is not machine-verified.

Resultants over rational polynomial coefficients, Bareiss elimination, algebraic field arithmetic with interval branch selection, reciprocals and general algebraic-coordinate predicates are independently tested and documented, not machine-verified.

Circular arc membership/order/subdivision, endpoint-cell intersection, general-coordinate circle classification and trusted correlated-point registry use construction arguments and independent cyclic-index tests, not full runtime machine verification.

Algebraic line trims and mixed line/arc noding, all-pairs cut completeness, semantic vertex welding, canonical edge merging and oriented source uses are documented and differentially tested, not full TypeScript machine verification.
Curve tangent/curvature germ sorting, half-edge permutations and boundary walks use documented geometric arguments and independent planar/sector checks, not full TypeScript machine verification.

Curved face grouping by exact vertical visibility, vertical-only component attachment, algebraic point location and principal algebraic square roots use construction arguments and differential tests, not machine-verified TypeScript execution.

Curved region winding propagation, regularized Boolean face selection, boundary reconstruction and filled-region location use construction arguments and independent tests, not machine-verified TypeScript execution.

3D algebraic coordinates, trusted factory correlation, plane/cylinder predicates, finite/contained line and segment intersections and supporting-surface coincidence are independently tested and supported by arithmetic identities, not whole-program machine verification; bounded BRep faces and shell certification are not provided by the surface API.

Rational plane-chart mapping/inversion, bounded algebraic line trims, affine images of circular arcs, whole-curve surface membership and connected surface loops use construction arguments and independent tests, not machine-verified TypeScript execution; a validated loop is not a certified BRep face or shell.
